title: The ring of five knots with one five-place knot
claim: Under the fewest counts the ring of four four-place knots and one five-place knot grows as the (v, S) model (cylinder positions with sets of lifts of the five-place knot below them): c(t) = sum_v C(m(v), t - h(v)) = c(t-5) + c(t-6), rate the real root of x^6 = x + 1 (about 1.1347). Proposition 1 (the count) proved; Proposition 2 (the identification) proved, its group step by the referee's exact argument (a join-closed set with a modular rank: pairwise candidates are a sunflower or the lower covers of one element), and checked exactly (isomorphism at rounds 8-20; the referee's histograms in every round to 53).
standard_statement: Least cube completion of a five-cycle of parity constraints with one extra variable; diagonal sums of Pascal's triangle.
prior_work: TOUCH-CENSUS-20261118-001, FIRST-KNOT-20261118-001A, FRESH-COUNT-20261118-001A; the advisor's model.
completion_gate: Ticket B's checks; referee R1 (confirmed, no Block).

validation.status: model from the advisor (Fable 5.2), checked by isomorphism and counts; refereed R1 (confirmed, no Block; step 3 re-derived exactly)
validation.independence: the TOUCH-CENSUS referee's independent counts to 57 rounds; referee R1's fresh code: counts and (parents, fresh) histograms equal in rounds 1 to 53

attained_result: Propositions 1 and 2; other rings per the advisor's formula (R1, R2 checked).
